full_prompt_en: A square, cubist-style painted still life arranges a dark bottle, small vessels, and a stemmed cup against a layered field of ocher, charcoal, and dusty cream. The background is assembled from tall and short rectangular planes, with a rough gray surface visible along the far left and upper edge. In the upper-left area, a pale ocher arch curves behind the neck of a nearly black bottle. Its narrow opening and broad rounded body are described by simple dark silhouettes and a small warm highlight. To the right, overlapping cream and terracotta rectangles interrupt one another, and a darker curved shape sits inside the pale block near the upper center. Across the middle of the image, several shallow upright compartments and orange-brown panels meet in a tight grid. Their surfaces look like painted paper or canvas, carrying fine grain, uneven color, and faint scratches. A small pale bowl stands at the lower left, its round rim compressed into an ellipse and its foot reduced to a dark wedge. Near the lower center, a warm salmon-colored goblet widens at the rim and narrows onto a delicate stem. A vertical orange plane rises behind it, while the black edge of the bottle reappears among the adjacent blocks. Along the bottom, a broad gray shelf projects horizontally and anchors the grouped objects. Below that shelf, a dark charcoal strip closes the frame, and a curved orange-red form enters from the lower-left corner. The objects and their surrounding planes overlap without a single consistent perspective; edges stay crisp in some places and soften into textured paint in others. Light is gentle and diffuse, suggested by warm ocher highlights and cooler gray facets rather than by a cast shadow from one source. The overall composition is dense and architectural in its arrangement, balancing small recognizable vessels against large geometric fields in a muted warm-and-cool palette.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形立体主义式静物绘画，把一只深色瓶子、几件小容器和一只高脚杯排列在赭黄、炭灰与灰奶油色层叠的背景前。背景由高矮不同的矩形色面拼成，最左侧和上缘仍露出粗糙的灰色底面。左上区域，一道浅赭色拱形弧线位于近黑色瓶颈后方。瓶子狭窄的开口和宽圆的瓶身由简洁的深色剪影与一处微暖亮色表现。右边，奶油色与陶土色矩形互相遮挡，上部中央的浅色色块中嵌着一处更深的弧形。画面中部，几块浅浅的直立分隔和橙褐色面拼成紧密的网格。它们的表面像涂过颜料的纸或画布，带细颗粒、深浅不均的颜色和淡淡划痕。左下方放着一只浅色小碗，圆口被压成椭圆，底足简化为深色楔形。靠近下方中央，一只暖鲑红色高脚杯的杯口向外张开，向下收成纤细杯脚。它后方竖起一道橙色色面，瓶子的黑色边缘又在相邻色块间出现。沿底部，一块宽阔的灰色台面水平伸出，固定这组物件。台面下方，一条深炭灰色带收住画面，弯曲的橙红形体从左下角进入。物件与周围色面互相重叠，却没有统一的透视；有些边缘锐利，有些则融入带肌理的颜料。光线柔和而漫散，通过暖赭色亮面和偏冷的灰色切面体现，并非来自单一光源的清晰投影。整体构图紧密，具有建筑般的组织性，以沉静的冷暖配色平衡可辨认的小器物与大片几何色面。
style_prompt_en: The painting breaks visible forms into interlocking rectangles, arcs, wedges, and flattened curves. Overlap and abrupt changes of scale create a shallow, shifting space without relying on continuous perspective. Some contours are hard and ruler-like, while others are worn by granular pigment and faint scratches. Muted ocher, burnt orange, terracotta, warm cream, charcoal, and cool gray recur as blocks of unequal size, with small dark anchors stabilizing the brighter planes. Color transitions are mostly stepped rather than smoothly blended, although the matte surface retains subtle variation inside each block. Illumination reads as diffuse: alternating warm and cool facets create volume without a theatrical beam or heavy cast shadow. A firm horizontal base gathers the denser center while peripheral planes interrupt the frame edges. The overall effect is tactile and measured, with geometric compression and textured color doing the work of description.
style_prompt_zh: 绘画把可见形体拆成互相嵌合的矩形、弧线、楔形和压平的曲线。重叠与突然改变的尺度形成浅而游移的空间，不依赖连续透视。有些轮廓坚硬得像尺画出来，另一些则被颗粒颜料和淡淡划痕磨损。低调的赭黄、焦橙、陶土红、暖奶油色、炭黑和冷灰以大小不等的色块反复出现，细小深色支点稳定较亮的平面。色彩过渡大多呈阶梯式，而非平滑晕染，哑光表面中的每块颜色又保留细微变化。光照显得漫散：交替的暖冷切面形成体积，却没有戏剧性的光束或浓重投影。明确的水平底部收拢密集的中心，外围色面则在画框边缘被截断。整体效果触感鲜明而有分寸，以几何压缩和带肌理的色彩完成描绘。
theme_en: A geometric still life of vessels and cups
theme_zh: 由瓶器和杯盏构成的几何静物
name: Juan Gris
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
